articles.summary: Efinopegdutide demonstrated a statistically significant greater proportion of participants achieved MASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis versus placebo at 52 weeks Meaningful improvements were observed in liver fibrosis without worsening of steatohepatitis, a key secondary histologic endpoint Results presented at The Liver Meeting® and published in The Lancet Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, today announced the presentation of positive results from the company’s Phase 2b clinical trial that evaluated the safety and efficacy of three doses of once-weekly, subcutaneous efinopegdutide (4 mg, 7 mg and 10 mg), an investigational injectable GLP-1/glucagon receptor co-agonist, versus placebo for the treatment of adults with MASH and stage F2 or F3 liver fibrosis. The findings were presented during a late-breaking abstract session at The Liver Meeting (TLM), being held in Denver, Colo., and simultaneously published in The Lancet . “MASH poses a
articles.title: Merck Announces Positive Results from Phase 2b Trial of Efinopegdutide in Adults with Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH) and Stage 2-3 Fibrosis

articles.summary: Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, today announced the discontinuation of the clinical development program evaluating nemtabrutinib (MK-1026), an investigational, oral, non-covalent Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor. Nemtabrutinib is being evaluated for patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), small lymphocytic leukemia (SLL) and other hematologic malignancies in the BELLWAVE program. Merck is discontinuing the Phase 3 BELLWAVE-011 trial ( NCT06136559 ) following review of the results by an external Data Monitoring Committee (eDMC) that suggested the benefits may not outweigh the risks in this study. Merck subsequently confirmed this following a review of the data in its totality, and as a result of this analysis, Merck has also made the decision to discontinue the broader BELLWAVE clinical development program, including the other Phase 3 studies: BELLWAVE-008 and BELLWAVE-010. Merck is informing study investigators for these
articles.title: Merck Announces Update on BELLWAVE Clinical Development Program Evaluating Nemtabrutinib

articles.summary: Presentations include data on daily and investigational once-weekly oral treatments and investigational once-monthly oral HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis New data include Phase 3 subgroup analyses and patient-reported outcomes of investigational once-weekly oral combination of islatravir/lenacapavir (ISL/LEN) Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, announced today that new data across its HIV treatment and prevention pipeline and portfolio will be presented at HIV Drug Therapy Glasgow 2026 ( HIV Glasgow 2026 ), taking place Nov 8–11, 2026, in Glasgow, Scotland. Presentations will highlight Merck’s strategy to expand oral options in both HIV treatment and prevention, including data on once-daily IDVYNSO ® (doravirine/islatravir), the investigational once-weekly oral treatment regimens islatravir/lenacapavir (ISL/LEN) and islatravir/ulonivirine (ISL/ULO), and the investigational once-monthly oral pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) alimatravir (AMI, MK-8527).
articles.title: Merck to Present New Data from Its Broad Oral HIV Portfolio and Pipeline at HIV Glasgow 2026

articles.summary: Some children up to 24 months of age remain vulnerable to severe RSV in their second RSV season – underscoring the importance of preventive options for this at-risk population Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, announced today that the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) of the European Medicines Agency (EMA) adopted a positive opinion recommending the approval of an expanded indication for ENFLONSIA ® (clesrovimab) to include prevention of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) in children up to 24 months of age at increased risk for severe RSV disease through their second RSV season. The CHMP recommendation will now be reviewed by the European Commission (EC) for marketing authorization in the European Union (EU), Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and a final decision is expected in the next two months. articles.title: Merck Receives Positive EU CHMP Opinion to Expand Marketing Authorization for ENFLONSIA® (clesrovimab) to Include Children Up to 24 Months of Age Who Remain Vulnerable to Severe RSV Disease Through Their Second RSV Season

articles.summary: ENHANCE-3 study represents Merck’s commitment to addressing the burden of COPD exacerbations OHTUVAYRE® is the first and only novel inhaled mechanism for the maintenance treatment of COPD in more than 20 years to combine bronchodilation and non-corticosteroid anti-inflammatory effects Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, today announced the initiation of ENHANCE-3 ( NCT07874815 ), a Phase 3 randomized clinical trial evaluating OHTUVAYRE (ensifentrine) for the prevention of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) exacerbations in adult patients receiving standard of care (SOC) with a history of exacerbations. Recruitment of the ENHANCE-3 trial has begun, and the first patients are now enrolling in the United States. “Many patients with COPD continue to experience persistent symptoms such as shortness of breath, despite current standard-of-care therapy. For these patients, exacerbations remain a major driver of disease progression and diminished
articles.title: Merck Initiates Phase 3 Study Evaluating OHTUVAYRE® (ensifentrine) for the Prevention of COPD Exacerbations in Adult Patients Receiving Standard of Care With a History of Exacerbations

articles.summary: Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, and Isomorphic Labs, an AI-first drug design and development company, today announced a research collaboration that brings together Isomorphic Labs’ AI approach to drug discovery with Merck’s rich proprietary data resources and deep discovery experience. The companies will collaborate to discover therapeutic small molecule candidates against an oncology target of strategic importance. Isomorphic Labs will perform in silico predictions and deliver molecular designs, applying its proprietary drug design engine (IsoDDE) incorporating select high-quality proprietary data sets supplied by Merck for the purpose of this collaboration. Merck will be responsible for preclinical and clinical development, as well as manufacturing and commercialization of any products derived from the collaboration. articles.title: Merck and Isomorphic Labs Enter Strategic Research Collaboration

articles.summary: Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside the United States and Canada, today announced that Thomas H. Glocer intends to retire from the Merck Board of Directors at the Company’s Annual Meeting of Shareholders in May 2027. The independent members of the Board have appointed Douglas M. Baker, Jr., as independent lead director, effective Jan. 1, 2027, succeeding Mr. Glocer in the role. Mr. Baker has served on the Merck Board of Directors since 2022. He has wide-ranging expertise in corporate governance and organizational management, including a deep understanding of global marketing, sales and operations of public companies. Previously, Mr. Baker was chairman and chief executive officer of Ecolab Inc., a provider of water and hygiene services and technologies for the food, hospitality, industrial and energy markets. articles.title: Thomas H. Glocer to Retire From Merck Board of Directors in May 2027; Douglas M. Baker, Jr. Appointed Independent Lead Director

articles.title: Merck Announces TroFuse-015 Trial Evaluating Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT) Met Primary Endpoint of Overall Survival (OS) in Third-Line or Later Locally Advanced Unresectable or Metastatic Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma

This recommendation will now be reviewed by the European Commission (EC) for marketing authorization
